primary_estimand: Per tissue (PFC, hippocampus, colon, liver, TA muscle), expression differences of each of the five other groups vs LPAEx (Ang(1-7) probiotic + exercise) in a 3x2 probiotic x exercise design; the exercise effect the paper interprets is LPAEx vs LPASed (S4.p4), with LPAEx vs LPSed/CONSed as combined-intervention contrasts.
inclusion: Aged (24 mo) male F344BN rats, n=4-6/group/tissue (S2.4.3.p1, TAB1); deposited 179 samples: 6/group/tissue except liver LPEx n=5 (LPEx3 liver absent, as in TAB1).
planned_contrasts: LPAEx vs LPASed in each tissue (S2.4.3.2.p1)
LPAEx vs LPSed in each tissue (S2.4.3.2.p1)
LPAEx vs CONSed in each tissue (S2.4.3.2.p1)
LPAEx vs CONEx in each tissue (S2.4.3.2.p1)
LPAEx vs LPEx in each tissue (S2.4.3.2.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 ~group (6-level single factor) per tissue, R 4.1.2 (S2.4.3.2.p1)
paper_results: PFC: vs LPASed 317 (262/55), vs LPSed 203 (163/40), vs CONSed 170 (140/30), vs LPEx 14, vs CONEx 4 (TAB2). Liver: vs CONEx 258 (252/6), vs LPSed 143, vs LPASed 112 (105/7), vs CONSed 73 (63/10), vs LPEx 19 (TAB3). Muscle vs CONEx 15 (9/6); hippocampus vs CONSed 19 (5/14); other muscle/hippocampus/colon comparisons 2-14 (S3.4.p1).
